text_block_list.text:
Wah, amazing...! You're really good at 
this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So many...! They'd look so cute all lined 
up together.
choice_data_list:
Then I'll give them all to you as a 
present, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But... I thought you wanted it, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: なら全部、ダンツにプレゼントするよ
choice_data_list_en: Then I'll give them all to Dantsu as a present.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: 楽しそうに見ていたから、欲しいのかなって
choice_data_list_en: You looked like you were enjoying it so much, I thought you might want it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I've had my eye on Paka Petit for a 
while now. I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll cherish eve~ry 
single one!
